title: Granularity from spectral sparsity
statement: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$. For a natural number $s$, the spectral-sparsity granularity is the degree Fourier granularity at degree $\lfloor\log_2 s\rfloor$.
